title: RootHealth adapted native $LogFile replay coverage and preflight audit
scope_note: This table audits the fixed roothealth_log_replay_plan sync/redo path (opts=1, optn=TRUE, optu=FALSE). It does not qualify the dormant undo/time-reversal CLI path.

preflight_strengths.detail: roothealth_log_replay_plan fixes plan-only sync mode (optn=TRUE, opts=1), rejects hibernation, uses a typed rh_writer, and never calls rh_writer_commit.
Restart pages are selected through libntfs ntfs_check_logfile and action/page walks have explicit step and action-count ceilings.
Physical mutations are converted into RH_WRITE_LOGFILE_REDO or RH_WRITE_LOGFILE_RESTART plans and direct replay writes are refused.

findings.title: Only the first non-overlapping action on an RCRD page is fully validated
findings.evidence: backward_rcrd calls likelyop() for the first record, then accepts every later record based only on client_data_length/size before enqueue_action.
findings.impact: A later record can bypass opcode range, transaction-id, offset, contiguity and pair-shape checks; it then reaches dispatch and helper code.
findings.required_gate: Call one centralized strict validator for every complete or overlapped record before enqueue; reject the page/plan on any failure.

findings.title: likelyop does not prove LCN-list or redo/undo payload extents fit the allocated action
findings.evidence: It checks alignment and minimum data offsets but never proves 80+8*lcns_to_follow, get_redo_offset()+redo_length, get_undo_offset()+undo_length, or extra/name data are <= client_data_length+0x30.
findings.impact: Helpers can read beyond ACTION_RECORD, misinterpret payload as LCN entries, dereference NULL payloads, or derive attacker-controlled lengths.
findings.required_gate: Validate the complete LOG_RECORD variable layout with overflow-safe arithmetic before any display, refresh, classification, I/O or dispatch.

findings.title: Raw-cluster count and protected-record slice are not bounded before allocation/copy
findings.evidence: read_raw allocates clustersz*lcns_to_follow and indexes lcn_list without proving either extent; read_protected/write_protected copy at cluster_index<<9 without proving pos+record_size <= clustersz*count.
findings.impact: Malformed native log data can cause out-of-bounds reads/writes, excessive allocation, and arbitrary physical-range planning attempts before helper checks.
findings.required_gate: Cap clusters/action, validate multiplication, LCN-list bytes, every LCN against volume geometry, and protected slice bounds before read_raw.

findings.title: Malformed or absent RCRD update-sequence arrays are accepted
findings.evidence: replaceusa validates only when xusa/nusa and its shape predicate are already true; otherwise it returns no error and read_buffer marks the page safe.
findings.impact: RCRD pages without valid MST protection can enter record parsing, unlike the strictly validated restart pages.
findings.required_gate: Require exact USA offset/count/range for every RCRD page and reject any mismatch or absent protection.

findings.title: Wrong redo/undo pair returns success for 22 handler-backed redo opcodes
findings.evidence: distribute_redos initializes err=0; conditional pair branches have no rejecting else; play_one_redo increments redocount after dispatch.
findings.impact: A required committed operation can be skipped silently and the caller can still plan clean restart pages, discarding evidence that replay remains incomplete.
findings.required_gate: Use an exhaustive typed pair table before target reads; every unapproved pair must fail closed and must not increment replayed-action counters.

findings.title: Bitmap bit range is unchecked
findings.evidence: redo_force_bits reads firstbit/count then calls ntfs_bit_set count times; the source TODO explicitly notes the missing firstbit+count bound.
findings.impact: SetBits/ClearBits can write beyond the allocated cluster buffer in plan-only mode.
findings.required_gate: Require an 8-byte BITMAP_ACTION payload and firstbit+count <= 8*clustersz*lcns_to_follow with overflow-safe arithmetic.

findings.title: Resident resize helpers are explicitly incomplete and reachable
findings.evidence: expand_resident labels its idempotence test wrong; shrink_resident lacks attribute/bytes_in_use bounds and uses a fake not-shrunk assumption.
findings.impact: Unequal-length UpdateResidentValue and WriteEndofFileRecordSegment can move/resize unrelated MFT bytes or misclassify already-applied state.
findings.required_gate: Deny unequal-length variants until attribute-local, bytes_in_use, capacity, overlap and expected-before invariants are fully implemented and tested.

findings.title: Win10Action37 always reports success
findings.evidence: redo_action37 sets err from write_protected or diagnoses a bad target, then unconditionally assigns err=0.
findings.impact: Invalid targets and failed typed-write planning are hidden; replay can be declared successful.
findings.required_gate: Preserve errors and define/validate the complete Action37 format before qualification.

findings.title: Dump/control operations have inconsistent or unchecked semantics
findings.evidence: OpenAttributeTableDump and AttributeNamesDump are parsed in refresh_attributes without complete payload bounds; DirtyPageTableDump is ignored; TransactionTableDump is called ignored in play_one_redo but errors in distribute_redos.
findings.impact: Attribute classification can be built from out-of-range data, dirty-page state is lost, and valid transaction-table records may abort depending on dispatch stage.
findings.required_gate: Give each dump opcode an exact bounded grammar and explicit semantic role, or deny the whole replay set before any plan is accepted.

findings.title: Commit marking matches transaction id without validating the LSN chain
findings.evidence: mark_transactions starts at ForgetTransaction and marks every earlier action with the same transaction_id and this_lsn<=committed_lsn; client_previous_lsn/client_undo_next_lsn are not checked.
findings.impact: Stale or unrelated actions with a reused/forged transaction id can be marked for redo.
findings.required_gate: Validate transaction-chain topology, monotonic/in-page LSN encoding, restart window membership, and unique termination before marking.

findings.title: Per-action helpers dereference record/attribute targets before complete local bounds proof
findings.evidence: Many helpers form ATTR_RECORD/INDEX pointers or read target+8 before proving record_offset, attribute_offset, target, payload, attribute length and record bytes_in_use are in range; right-justified target subtraction can underflow.
findings.impact: Even when raw I/O succeeds, crafted offsets can cause OOB access or metadata moves outside the intended attribute/index entry.
findings.required_gate: Add operation-specific preflight that returns a typed validated view; helpers must consume only validated offsets/ranges and expected-before bytes.

findings.title: Dynamic attribute-table construction is not fail-atomic or fully bounded
findings.evidence: getattrentry updates attrcount across realloc failure paths; refresh/open parsing derives variable name/table extents without a central record-end check; UpdateNonResidentValue depends on this table for target kind.
findings.impact: Allocation failure or malformed dump data can corrupt classification state and route a nonresident update to INDX or raw clusters incorrectly.
findings.required_gate: Build the table in a bounded temporary structure, validate all dumps first, then publish atomically; deny ambiguous target kinds.

findings.title: redo_actions counts ignored controls and clean restart planning is not tied to physical semantic completion
findings.evidence: redocount increments for every successful distribute_redos call, including Noop/Forget/dumps; roothealth_log_replay_plan plans clean restart pages whenever walk returns success.
findings.impact: Metrics overstate repaired actions and ignored/silently skipped records can still lead to a clean journal state.
findings.required_gate: Track examined, control-consumed, physically-planned, already-applied and rejected counts separately; clean only after every committed record has an approved terminal state.

integration_preconditions: This low-level API accepts only a device path/writer; T1OS serial+UUID identity and full namespace proof must be enforced by the caller before the resulting plan is committed.
A persistent typed WAL must cover every planned redo and both restart-page writes before mutation; this audit does not qualify the WAL implementation.
No unsupported, ignored-semantic or ambiguous pair may be bypassed merely because a later checker reports a clean namespace.

required_qualification_sequence: Strictly validate every RCRD page MST/header and every record variable layout.
Classify the exact redo/undo pair from a closed machine-readable allowlist before target I/O.
Validate transaction chains and restart-window LSNs.
Resolve target type and physical ranges from trusted NTFS metadata, not unchecked log hints.
Run operation-specific bounds/idempotence preflight and produce a typed validated view.
Plan writes through rh_writer; require exact semantic outcome accounting.
Only then plan two clean restart pages.
